hookOptions: How a blue QR code saved India's smallest street vendors.
This tiny sticker did what major banks couldn't do.
Remember when you couldn't buy chai without exact change?
plan.hook: This tiny sticker did what major banks couldn't do.
plan.title: How a simple QR sticker revolutionized India's street shops
plan.description: Discover how UPI and a simple sticker brought millions of micro-merchants into the digital economy overnight.

scenes.visualQuery: close up UPI QR code sticker on rustic wooden tea stall street
scenes.voiceover: This tiny paper sticker did what giant global banks couldn't do.

scenes.visualQuery: indian shopkeeper searching cash drawer frustrated customer waiting
scenes.voiceover: Remember the daily struggle for exact change? No change often meant a lost sale.

scenes.visualQuery: hand scanning QR code with smartphone street vendor close up
scenes.voiceover: Then came UPI. Instantly, a ten-rupee cup of tea could be paid digitally with zero fees.

scenes.visualQuery: happy indian vegetable vendor looking at smartphone smiling screen
scenes.voiceover: It gave local sellers a digital footprint, helping them get bank loans for the first time.

scenes.visualQuery: paytm soundbox on counter shopkeeper busy in background
scenes.onScreenText: Audio alerts solved the trust gap.
scenes.voiceover: Now, smart speakers announce payments out loud, saving busy vendors from checking screens.

scenes.visualQuery: bustling indian street market night vibrant lights crowd shopping
scenes.onScreenText: When did you last use cash?
scenes.voiceover: It turned street vendors into fintech leaders. When was the last time you used actual cash?

review.feedback:
* Tighten the visual pacing in Scene 2 and Scene 3; 6 seconds is too long to show a single action like searching a drawer or scanning a QR code.
* Ensure the visual in Scene 1 immediately zooms in on the sticker to instantly match the curiosity of the hook.
* The transition to Scene 5 feels slightly abrupt; tweak the voiceover to connect the soundbox directly to the busy street environment.
